evidence_items.explanation: The researchers constructed three question-answering datasets on which ChatGPT and GPT-4 repeatedly supplied incorrect answers and supporting claims. This supports the recurring-hallucination component, not a general deterioration over time or a frequency across all ordinary uses.

The period-matched evaluation reports gains and regressions across models and tasks, including poorer GPT-4 prime-number performance and more code-formatting mistakes. These findings support specific deterioration but do not measure a general worsening of AI.

evidence_items.locator: Body paragraph describing the annual CEO study
evidence_items.explanation: IBM reports substantial self-reported integration alongside doubts about readiness and concerns about accuracy. It does not establish maximum-speed adoption or that executives deployed AI despite demonstrated unsuitability.

unresolved_gaps: No representative aggregate measure establishes a general deterioration across relevant AI systems.
The survey does not connect particular adoption decisions with known unsuitable applications.
Reported concern about risks does not prove that companies acted on those concerns.
The available evidence does not measure adoption against an as-fast-as-possible benchmark.
